picture.alt: A sunny riverbank under a willow tree. An old man with a long grey beard and grey hair in a topknot, in a mustard-yellow robe, sits on a low stone wall with one hand on his chin, smiling and listening. A young man in a dark teal robe leans in behind him. On the left a child in a blue robe, hair in a bun with a red ribbon, talks with both hands open; on the right a child in a rust-red robe stands talking and points up at the bright sun in the top right corner. Behind them a grey stone arch bridge crosses the river, and a small covered wooden boat is tied to a post in the water near the bridge, with nobody on it.

picture.alt: Inside an old hall with red pillars, open to a courtyard with grey tiled roofs; the leaves of a big green tree fill the top of the picture. At the left end of a long dark wooden table sits an old man with a long grey beard and grey hair in a topknot tied with a blue ribbon, in a mustard-yellow robe; he smiles and talks with both hands open towards the others, looking at them, not at the table. An unrolled bamboo scroll lies on the table; nobody is reading it, holding a brush or writing. Facing him at the table sit three listeners, each with a hand at the chin: a man with a black beard in a teal robe, a smiling child in a brown robe, and a young woman with long black hair in a pink robe.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你上個週末去山上玩，好玩嗎？
lines.simplified: 你上个周末去山上玩，好玩吗？

questions.why: 本來想買一束花，後來想起來老師最喜歡喝茶: he remembered she loves tea and bought that instead of flowers. The card and the cookies are the woman's gifts.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 聽說妳下個月要搬到台南去了，是真的嗎？
lines.simplified: 听说你下个月要搬到台南去了，是真的吗？
lines.pinyin: Tīngshuō nǐ xià ge yuè yào bān dào Táinán qù le, shì zhēn de ma?
lines.english: I hear you're moving to Tainan next month. Is that true?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 誰說的？我可沒說要搬家。我只是說下個月要去台南住兩個星期。
lines.simplified: 谁说的？我可没说要搬家。我只是说下个月要去台南住两个星期。
lines.pinyin: Shéi shuō de? Wǒ kě méi shuō yào bānjiā. Wǒ zhǐshì shuō xià ge yuè yào qù Táinán zhù liǎng ge xīngqí.
lines.english: Who said that? I never said I was moving. I only said I'm going to stay in Tainan for two weeks next month.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 去玩嗎？
lines.simplified: 去玩吗？
lines.pinyin: Qù wán ma?
lines.english: On holiday?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 不是。教授要帶我們去看那裡的孔廟和老房子，了解古代的教育，還要去一所小學，看看現在的學生怎麼上課。回來以後，每個人都得交一篇報告。
lines.simplified: 不是。教授要带我们去看那里的孔庙和老房子，了解古代的教育，还要去一所小学，看看现在的学生怎么上课。回来以后，每个人都得交一篇报告。
lines.pinyin: Bú shì. Jiàoshòu yào dài wǒmen qù kàn nàlǐ de Kǒngmiào hé lǎo fángzi, liǎojiě gǔdài de jiàoyù, hái yào qù yì suǒ xiǎoxué, kànkàn xiànzài de xuéshēng zěnme shàngkè. Huílái yǐhòu, měi ge rén dōu děi jiāo yì piān bàogào.
lines.english: No. Our professor is taking us to see the Confucius Temple and the old houses there, to learn about education in ancient times, and to a primary school to see how pupils have class today. When we're back, everyone has to hand in a report.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 聽起來很有意思。不過台南現在很熱吧？
lines.simplified: 听起来很有意思。不过台南现在很热吧？
lines.pinyin: Tīng qǐlái hěn yǒu yìsi. Búguò Táinán xiànzài hěn rè ba?
lines.english: Sounds interesting. But Tainan must be hot now?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 對，聽說每天都有三十四度。
lines.simplified: 对，听说每天都有三十四度。
lines.pinyin: Duì, tīngshuō měi tiān dōu yǒu sānshísì dù.
lines.english: Yes, I hear it's thirty-four degrees every day.

prompt.speaker: N

prompt.simplified: 女的是什么意思？

prompt.english: What does the woman mean?

choices.english: She has no plan to move.

choices.english: She is going to Tainan on holiday for two weeks.

choices.pinyin: Yào zài Táinán zhù yí ge yuè.
choices.english: She will stay in Tainan for a month.

questions.why: 我可沒說要搬家: 可 + 沒 firmly denies the rumour. She is only staying in Tainan for two weeks, and for a class trip, not a holiday.

prompt.simplified: 这次去台南，学生要做什么？

prompt.english: What will the students do on this trip to Tainan?

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段話，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段话，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn huà, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a short talk, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 大家好，歡迎坐我們的船。我們會先往東開，經過一個小公園，再從那座橋下面過去。
lines.simplified: 大家好，欢迎坐我们的船。我们会先往东开，经过一个小公园，再从那座桥下面过去。
lines.pinyin: Dàjiā hǎo, huānyíng zuò wǒmen de chuán. Wǒmen huì xiān wǎng dōng kāi, jīngguò yí ge xiǎo gōngyuán, zài cóng nà zuò qiáo xiàmiàn guòqù.
lines.english: Hello everyone, and welcome aboard. We'll head east first, past a small park, and then go under that bridge.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 十點半，船會在一座老廟旁邊停下來，大家可以下船走一走、照照相。
lines.simplified: 十点半，船会在一座老庙旁边停下来，大家可以下船走一走、照照相。
lines.pinyin: Shí diǎn bàn, chuán huì zài yí zuò lǎo miào pángbiān tíng xiàlái, dàjiā kěyǐ xià chuán zǒu yì zǒu, zhào zhàoxiàng.
lines.english: At half past ten the boat will stop beside an old temple, and you can get off for a walk and some photos.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 廟裡有很多大樹，比較涼快，不過風很大，最好帶一件外套。
lines.simplified: 庙里有很多大树，比较凉快，不过风很大，最好带一件外套。
lines.pinyin: Miào lǐ yǒu hěn duō dà shù, bǐjiào liángkuài, búguò fēng hěn dà, zuìhǎo dài yí jiàn wàitào.
lines.english: There are lots of big trees in the temple grounds, so it's cooler, but it's windy, so you'd better take a jacket.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 十一點我們必須準時開船，所以請大家在十點五十分以前回到船上。
lines.simplified: 十一点我们必须准时开船，所以请大家在十点五十分以前回到船上。
lines.pinyin: Shíyī diǎn wǒmen bìxū zhǔnshí kāi chuán, suǒyǐ qǐng dàjiā zài shí diǎn wǔshí fēn yǐqián huí dào chuán shàng.
lines.english: We must leave at eleven sharp, so please be back on board before ten fifty.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 船會在哪裡停下來？
prompt.simplified: 船会在哪里停下来？
prompt.pinyin: Chuán huì zài nǎlǐ tíng xiàlái?
prompt.english: Where will the boat stop?

questions.why: 停下來 is where the boat comes to a stop: beside the old temple at half past ten. It only passes the park and goes under the bridge, and the big trees are in the temple grounds.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 大家下船以後，有多少時間走走？
prompt.simplified: 大家下船以后，有多少时间走走？
prompt.pinyin: Dàjiā xià chuán yǐhòu, yǒu duōshǎo shíjiān zǒuzǒu?
prompt.english: Once off the boat, how long do people have to walk around?

questions.why: The boat stops at 10:30 and everyone must be back on board before 10:50: twenty minutes. Half an hour runs to the 11:00 departure, which is the boat's time, not the visitors'.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段介紹，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段介绍，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn jièshào, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a self-introduction, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 大家好，我是這學期教你們會話課的老師。我是美國人，十年前來台灣學過一年中文。
lines.simplified: 大家好，我是这学期教你们会话课的老师。我是美国人，十年前来台湾学过一年中文。
lines.pinyin: Dàjiā hǎo, wǒ shì zhè xuéqí jiāo nǐmen huìhuà kè de lǎoshī. Wǒ shì Měiguó rén, shí nián qián lái Táiwān xué guo yì nián Zhōngwén.
lines.english: Hello everyone. I'm your conversation teacher this semester. I'm American, and ten years ago I came to Taiwan to study Chinese for a year.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那時候我本來打算學完就回美國，誰知道我愛上了這裡的生活，就留下來了。
lines.simplified: 那时候我本来打算学完就回美国，谁知道我爱上了这里的生活，就留下来了。
lines.pinyin: Nà shíhòu wǒ běnlái dǎsuàn xué wán jiù huí Měiguó, shéi zhīdào wǒ ài shàng le zhèlǐ de shēnghuó, jiù liú xiàlái le.
lines.english: Back then I planned to go home to America as soon as I finished, but I fell in love with life here and stayed on.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我先在一家貿易公司工作了三年，後來發現自己最喜歡的還是教書，就來學校當老師了。
lines.simplified: 我先在一家贸易公司工作了三年，后来发现自己最喜欢的还是教书，就来学校当老师了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xiān zài yì jiā màoyì gōngsī gōngzuò le sān nián, hòulái fāxiàn zìjǐ zuì xǐhuān de háishì jiāoshū, jiù lái xuéxiào dāng lǎoshī le.
lines.english: First I worked at a trading company for three years; later I found that what I liked best was teaching, so I came to the school as a teacher.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 上課的時候，我只說中文。你們不能只聽不說，有任何問題都要馬上問我。
lines.simplified: 上课的时候，我只说中文。你们不能只听不说，有任何问题都要马上问我。
lines.pinyin: Shàngkè de shíhòu, wǒ zhǐ shuō Zhōngwén. Nǐmen bù néng zhǐ tīng bù shuō, yǒu rènhé wèntí dōu yào mǎshàng wèn wǒ.
lines.english: In class I speak only Chinese. You can't just listen without speaking, and if you have any question, ask me right away.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 這位老師學完中文以後，做了什麼？
prompt.simplified: 这位老师学完中文以后，做了什么？
prompt.pinyin: Zhè wèi lǎoshī xué wán Zhōngwén yǐhòu, zuò le shénme?
prompt.english: What did the teacher do after finishing his Chinese studies?

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Went back to America to teach Chinese.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Started teaching at a school straight away.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Went back to America to work for three years.

questions.why: 誰知道我愛上了這裡的生活，就留下來了: he meant to go home but stayed on in Taiwan, first at a trading company for three years and only then as a teacher.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 學生有問題的時候，老師要他們怎麼做？
prompt.simplified: 学生有问题的时候，老师要他们怎么做？
prompt.pinyin: Xuéshēng yǒu wèntí de shíhòu, lǎoshī yào tāmen zěnme zuò?
prompt.english: What does the teacher want students to do when they have a question?

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Think it through first, then ask.

choices.english: Go and ask the teacher at once.

questions.why: 有任何問題都要馬上問我: any question goes to him straight away, not after class, not after thinking it over, and not to a classmate first.

passage.traditional: 小時候，我跟哥哥常常吵架。有一次，哥哥走過我旁邊的時候，踢了我一{1}，我很{2}地推了他一下，兩個人就越吵越大聲。爸爸聽見了，馬上從樓上跑{3}。爸爸沒有生氣，只是讓我們坐好，說了一個古代的故事給我們聽。說完以後，爸爸說：「一家人{4}互相幫助，{5}遇到什麼事，都不能打架。」從那天起，我們就沒有再打過架了。
passage.simplified: 小时候，我跟哥哥常常吵架。有一次，哥哥走过我旁边的时候，踢了我一{1}，我很{2}地推了他一下，两个人就越吵越大声。爸爸听见了，马上从楼上跑{3}。爸爸没有生气，只是让我们坐好，说了一个古代的故事给我们听。说完以后，爸爸说：「一家人{4}互相帮助，{5}遇到什么事，都不能打架。」从那天起，我们就没有再打过架了。
passage.pinyin: Xiǎoshíhòu, wǒ gēn gēge chángcháng chǎojià. Yǒu yí cì, gēge zǒu guò wǒ pángbiān de shíhòu, tī le wǒ yì jiǎo, wǒ hěn jīdòng de tuī le tā yíxià, liǎng ge rén jiù yuè chǎo yuè dàshēng. Bàba tīngjiàn le, mǎshàng cóng lóushàng pǎo xiàlái. Bàba méiyǒu shēngqì, zhǐshì ràng wǒmen zuò hǎo, shuō le yí ge gǔdài de gùshì gěi wǒmen tīng. Shuō wán yǐhòu, bàba shuō: “Yì jiā rén bìxū hùxiāng bāngzhù, bùguǎn yùdào shénme shì, dōu bù néng dǎjià.” Cóng nà tiān qǐ, wǒmen jiù méiyǒu zài dǎ guo jià le.
passage.english: When I was little, my older brother and I quarrelled all the time. Once, as he walked past me, he gave me a kick, and I got worked up and pushed him, and the two of us got louder and louder. Dad heard us and ran straight down from upstairs. He didn't get angry; he only had us sit up straight and told us a story from ancient times. When he had finished, he said: “A family must help each other. Whatever happens, you can't fight.” Since that day we have never fought again.

questions.why: 踢 counts in kicks: 踢了我一腳, he gave me one kick. 一眼 is a glance, 一口 a bite, and 一遍 one time through something read or said.
After a kick the writer pushes back angrily: 很激動地推了他, worked up. Nobody pushes politely, and 涼快 and 偉大 don't describe how someone pushes.
從樓上跑下來: from upstairs he ran down to where the children were. 跑上去 and 跑回去 go away from them, and 跑起來 only means starting to run.
Dad states a rule: a family 必須 (must) help each other. 曾經 tells of something that happened once, 任何 goes before a noun, and 到底 asks a pressing question.
不管 + a question word (什麼事) + 都: whatever happens, you can't fight. 雖然 needs 可是, 因為 a reason, and 只要 goes with 就.

passage.traditional: 我奶奶{1}已經七十多歲了，可是身體還很好，每天早上都去公園慢跑。上個週末，我帶她去逛夜市。她看到一家賣臭豆腐的店，說她年輕的時候{2}吃過一次，可是已經忘了是什麼味道。我買了一盤給她，她吃了一{3}，就說：「太好吃了！」她想再買一些帶回家，老闆說只剩下兩盤了，她就把兩盤都買{4}了。回家的路上，她笑著說：「下次你{5}別忘了再帶我來！」
passage.simplified: 我奶奶{1}已经七十多岁了，可是身体还很好，每天早上都去公园慢跑。上个周末，我带她去逛夜市。她看到一家卖臭豆腐的店，说她年轻的时候{2}吃过一次，可是已经忘了是什么味道。我买了一盘给她，她吃了一{3}，就说：「太好吃了！」她想再买一些带回家，老板说只剩下两盘了，她就把两盘都买{4}了。回家的路上，她笑着说：「下次你{5}别忘了再带我来！」
passage.pinyin: Wǒ nǎinai suīrán yǐjīng qīshí duō suì le, kěshì shēntǐ hái hěn hǎo, měi tiān zǎoshàng dōu qù gōngyuán mànpǎo. Shàng ge zhōumò, wǒ dài tā qù guàng yèshì. Tā kàn dào yì jiā mài chòu dòufǔ de diàn, shuō tā niánqīng de shíhòu céngjīng chī guo yí cì, kěshì yǐjīng wàng le shì shénme wèidào. Wǒ mǎi le yì pán gěi tā, tā chī le yì kǒu, jiù shuō: “Tài hǎochī le!” Tā xiǎng zài mǎi yìxiē dài huí jiā, lǎobǎn shuō zhǐ shèngxià liǎng pán le, tā jiù bǎ liǎng pán dōu mǎi xiàlái le. Huí jiā de lù shàng, tā xiào zhe shuō: “Xià cì nǐ kě bié wàng le zài dài wǒ lái!”
passage.english: Although my grandmother is over seventy, she is still in good health and jogs in the park every morning. Last weekend I took her to the night market. She saw a stall selling stinky tofu and said she had eaten it once when she was young but had forgotten what it tasted like. I bought her a plate; she took one bite and said, “Delicious!” She wanted to buy more to take home; the owner said only two plates were left, so she bought both. On the way home she said with a smile, “Be sure to bring me again next time!”

questions.why: 雖然……可是……: although she is over seventy, she is still healthy. 因為, 要是 and 不管 don't pair with the 可是 that follows.
曾經 + V過: she once ate it, back when she was young. 永遠 (forever), 必須 (must) and 任何 (any) don't fit a single past experience.
吃 counts in bites: 吃了一口, she took one bite. 一眼 is a glance, 一腳 a kick, and 一遍 one time through something read or said.
買下來: she bought both plates and kept them. 買上去, 買出來 and 買進去 don't say that something was bought and kept.
可別忘了: be sure not to forget. 可 makes the reminder warm and firm; 才別, 到底別 and 又別 are not said.

text.traditional: 我小學的時候數學不好，有一位老師曾經在上課的時候說我笨，從那時候起，我就很怕上數學課。上了中學以後，我遇到了一位新的數學老師。她知道每個學生的程度都不一樣，所以總是先用簡單的例子說明，再慢慢地教難一點的。不管我問什麼問題，她都很認真地回答。有一次，她在我的作業上寫了一句話：「你一點都不笨，只是需要多一點時間。」這句話影響了我一輩子。現在我也當了老師，我希望我的學生都不怕問問題。
text.simplified: 我小学的时候数学不好，有一位老师曾经在上课的时候说我笨，从那时候起，我就很怕上数学课。上了中学以后，我遇到了一位新的数学老师。她知道每个学生的程度都不一样，所以总是先用简单的例子说明，再慢慢地教难一点的。不管我问什么问题，她都很认真地回答。有一次，她在我的作业上写了一句话：「你一点都不笨，只是需要多一点时间。」这句话影响了我一辈子。现在我也当了老师，我希望我的学生都不怕问问题。
text.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎoxué de shíhòu shùxué bù hǎo, yǒu yí wèi lǎoshī céngjīng zài shàngkè de shíhòu shuō wǒ bèn, cóng nà shíhòu qǐ, wǒ jiù hěn pà shàng shùxué kè. Shàng le zhōngxué yǐhòu, wǒ yùdào le yí wèi xīn de shùxué lǎoshī. Tā zhīdào měi ge xuéshēng de chéngdù dōu bù yíyàng, suǒyǐ zǒngshì xiān yòng jiǎndān de lìzi shuōmíng, zài mànmàn de jiāo nán yìdiǎn de. Bùguǎn wǒ wèn shénme wèntí, tā dōu hěn rènzhēn de huídá. Yǒu yí cì, tā zài wǒ de zuòyè shàng xiě le yí jù huà: “Nǐ yìdiǎn dōu bú bèn, zhǐshì xūyào duō yìdiǎn shíjiān.” Zhè jù huà yǐngxiǎng le wǒ yíbèizi. Xiànzài wǒ yě dāng le lǎoshī, wǒ xīwàng wǒ de xuéshēng dōu bú pà wèn wèntí.
text.english: In primary school I was bad at maths, and a teacher once called me stupid in class; from then on I dreaded maths lessons. When I started secondary school I met a new maths teacher. She knew every student's level was different, so she always explained with simple examples first and then slowly taught the harder things. Whatever I asked, she answered seriously. Once she wrote on my homework: “You're not stupid at all; you just need a little more time.” Those words have shaped my whole life. Now I'm a teacher too, and I hope none of my students are afraid to ask questions.

text.traditional: 去年我到台灣學中文。有一天早上，我在公園遇到一位老先生，他正在教幾個小朋友寫書法。我站在旁邊看了很久，老先生就笑著問我想不想學。我以為跟他學要付錢，誰知道他說不用，只要每個星期六早上八點來公園就可以了。第一次寫的時候，我寫了半個小時，一個字都沒寫好。老先生說：「慢慢寫，寫字跟做人一樣，不能急。」現在我已經學了一年了，字雖然還不太好看，可是我覺得自己沒有以前那麼急了。
text.simplified: 去年我到台湾学中文。有一天早上，我在公园遇到一位老先生，他正在教几个小朋友写书法。我站在旁边看了很久，老先生就笑着问我想不想学。我以为跟他学要付钱，谁知道他说不用，只要每个星期六早上八点来公园就可以了。第一次写的时候，我写了半个小时，一个字都没写好。老先生说：「慢慢写，写字跟做人一样，不能急。」现在我已经学了一年了，字虽然还不太好看，可是我觉得自己没有以前那么急了。
text.pinyin: Qùnián wǒ dào Táiwān xué Zhōngwén. Yǒu yì tiān zǎoshàng, wǒ zài gōngyuán yùdào yí wèi lǎo xiānshēng, tā zhèngzài jiāo jǐ ge xiǎopéngyǒu xiě shūfǎ. Wǒ zhàn zài pángbiān kàn le hěn jiǔ, lǎo xiānshēng jiù xiào zhe wèn wǒ xiǎng bù xiǎng xué. Wǒ yǐwéi gēn tā xué yào fù qián, shéi zhīdào tā shuō búyòng, zhǐyào měi ge xīngqíliù zǎoshàng bā diǎn lái gōngyuán jiù kěyǐ le. Dì yī cì xiě de shíhòu, wǒ xiě le bàn ge xiǎoshí, yí ge zì dōu méi xiě hǎo. Lǎo xiānshēng shuō: “Mànmàn xiě, xiězì gēn zuòrén yíyàng, bù néng jí.” Xiànzài wǒ yǐjīng xué le yì nián le, zì suīrán hái bú tài hǎokàn, kěshì wǒ juéde zìjǐ méiyǒu yǐqián nàme jí le.
text.english: Last year I came to Taiwan to study Chinese. One morning in the park I met an old man who was teaching a few children calligraphy. I stood watching for a long time, and he smiled and asked if I'd like to learn. I thought I would have to pay, but he said there was no need: I only had to come to the park at eight every Saturday morning. The first time, I wrote for half an hour and didn't get a single character right. He said, “Write slowly. Writing is like being a good person: you can't rush it.” I've been learning for a year now. My characters still aren't pretty, but I feel I'm not as impatient as I used to be.

Coming to the park at 8 p.m.

prompt.traditional: 老先生的話是什麼意思？
prompt.simplified: 老先生的话是什么意思？

text.traditional: 我的筆電已經用了五年，最近電池老是有問題，所以我想買一台新的。我本來打算在網路上買，可是朋友說，網路上的雖然便宜一點，可是有問題的時候不容易修理，不如去光華商場看看。上個星期六，朋友陪我去了。那裡賣筆電的店多得不得了，我自己看不出來哪一台比較好，還好朋友很懂，幫我比了三家店。最後，我買了一台比較輕的，因為我常常得出差。老闆不但給我打折，還送了我一個背包。
text.simplified: 我的笔电已经用了五年，最近电池老是有问题，所以我想买一台新的。我本来打算在网路上买，可是朋友说，网路上的虽然便宜一点，可是有问题的时候不容易修理，不如去光华商场看看。上个星期六，朋友陪我去了。那里卖笔电的店多得不得了，我自己看不出来哪一台比较好，还好朋友很懂，帮我比了三家店。最后，我买了一台比较轻的，因为我常常得出差。老板不但给我打折，还送了我一个背包。
text.pinyin: Wǒ de bǐdiàn yǐjīng yòng le wǔ nián, zuìjìn diànchí lǎoshì yǒu wèntí, suǒyǐ wǒ xiǎng mǎi yì tái xīn de. Wǒ běnlái dǎsuàn zài wǎnglù shàng mǎi, kěshì péngyǒu shuō, wǎnglù shàng de suīrán piányí yìdiǎn, kěshì yǒu wèntí de shíhòu bù róngyì xiūlǐ, bùrú qù Guānghuá Shāngchǎng kànkàn. Shàng ge xīngqíliù, péngyǒu péi wǒ qù le. Nàlǐ mài bǐdiàn de diàn duō de bùdéliǎo, wǒ zìjǐ kàn bù chūlái nǎ yì tái bǐjiào hǎo, háihǎo péngyǒu hěn dǒng, bāng wǒ bǐ le sān jiā diàn. Zuìhòu, wǒ mǎi le yì tái bǐjiào qīng de, yīnwèi wǒ chángcháng děi chūchāi. Lǎobǎn búdàn gěi wǒ dǎzhé, hái sòng le wǒ yí ge bēibāo.
text.english: I've had my laptop for five years, and lately the battery keeps giving trouble, so I wanted a new one. I was going to buy it online, but a friend said that although online is a bit cheaper, it's hard to get things fixed when something goes wrong, so I'd do better to look at Guanghua Digital Plaza. Last Saturday my friend went with me. There were loads of shops selling laptops, and I couldn't tell which was better, but luckily my friend knows them well and compared three shops for me. In the end I bought a lighter one, because I often travel for work. The owner not only gave me a discount but also threw in a backpack.
